more specifically one in the nature of a writ of mandamus declaring proceedings bearing reference number Rc.B.238/2018 dated 09-03- 2021, passed by the Sub-Collector Nandyal , i.e., Respondent Number 3 in rejecting the payment of compensation for lands of the petitioner resumed for public purpose on par with payment of Rs 5.50 Lakhs per acre as paid to patta holders and instead paying only Rs 4.20 lakhs per acre in respect of the land holding of the petitioner resumed by the respondents as illegal, contrary to the settled law laid down by the honourable High Court of Andhra Pradesh in Mekala Pandu case and and as confirmed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court' in Civil Appeal No 7904-7912 dated 04-08-2014 and consequently direct payment of the balance Rs.1.3 lakhs Per acre in respect of the land holding of the petitioner of Ac 5.00 cents in survey No. 839/1 of gani village, gadivemula Mandal, Nandyal District, AP duly duly setting aside the orders bearing reference number Rc.B.238/2018 dated 09- 03-2021 insofar as the petitioner is concerned with all applicable  2 P.V.Ramana vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164237987/

 3 THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE TARLADA RAJASEKHAR RAO  WRIT PETITION No.32011 of 2023 ORDER:
Learned counsel for petitioner appeared virtually and submitted that in view of amendment issued vide G.O.Ms.No.23, Revenue (Lands.I), dated 19.01.2024, the Andhra Pradesh Assigned Lands (Prohibition of Transfers) (Amendment) Act, 2023, this writ petition has been rendered infructuous.

 3 THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE TARLADA RAJASEKHAR RAO  WRIT PETITION No.32011 of 2023 ORDER:
Learned counsel for petitioner appeared virtually and submitted that in view of amendment issued vide G.O.Ms.No.23, Revenue (Lands.I), dated 19.01.2024, the Andhra Pradesh Assigned Lands (Prohibition of Transfers) (Amendment) Act, 2023, this writ petition has been rendered infructuous.
